system.description:
Once per mission you may introduce a new Contact. Name the contact, say what they do, then roll Style.

After you've rolled, describe how you contact them; the MC will ask some questions.

success.value: You've worked with the contact before; they have talent. Write them down as a Contact.

partial.value: You've never met them before, they're an unknown quantity.

failure.value: You know them all right. Tell the MC why they dislike you.
